description: This file defines the React component 'MultiverseExplorerView', which provides a UI for exploring multiverse paths, role recommendations, and mindmap visualizations related to career navigation. It includes functions for fetching and managing paths, bookmarks, and role data, as well as rendering components for path selection, role recommendations, and detailed path views.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an input to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined values.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Sanitizes an input by ensuring it is an array of non-empty strings.

methods.name: roleIdFromRec
methods.description: Generates a stable role ID from a record, based on available id or title.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRec
methods.description: Extracts the role title from a record.

methods.name: labelForPathType
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for a given multiverse path type.

methods.name: describePathType
methods.description: Provides a textual description of a specific path type.

methods.name: looksLikePathType
methods.description: Type guard to check if a string corresponds to a valid MultiversePathType.

methods.name: pathMatchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if a given path matches the current search filters such as title, industry, and skills.

methods.name: PathCard
methods.description: React component rendering a clickable card representing a career path, with bookmark toggle functionality.

methods.name: PathDetailPanel
methods.description: React component showing detailed information about a selected path, including steps, bookmarking, and navigation.

methods.name: normalizeBackendBookmarksToLocal
methods.description: Converts backend bookmark records into local bookmark objects with sorting.

methods.name: normalizeRecommendedRoles
methods.description: Processes raw backend role recommendations into a structured array of MultiverseRecommendedRole objects.

methods.name: MultiverseExplorerView
methods.description: Main React component providing the multiverse exploration interface, including paths, role recommendations, and mindmap visualization.

methods.name: resolveInitialMultiversePathType
methods.description: Determines the initial path type based on URL query parameters or last stored preferences.

methods.name: persistMultiversePathType
methods.description: Stores the selected path type for continuity across sessions.
